studies.name: Evaluation of Long-Term Safety and Toler
studies.why_not_contributing: its registered primaries are SAFETY outcomes -- treatment-emergent adverse events and events of special interest -- not cardiovascular events. Correctly excluded from a MACE estimate.
studies.registered_primary_measure: Percentage of Participants With Treatment-emergent Adverse Events (TEAEs)
studies.registered_primary_description_verbatim: TEAEs, defined as adverse events (AEs) that began or worsened in severity after the first dose of double-blind study drug and up to 30 days after receiving the last dose of double-blind study drug, were collected and reported.
studies.what_the_registry_holds_that_the_page_do: treatment-emergent adverse events in 78.5% on bempedoic acid against 78.7% on placebo, and a set of adverse events of special interest

why_not_contributing_CORRECTED_2026_08_1.the_recorded_reason_was_wrong: The recorded reason reads: 'its registered primaries are SAFETY outcomes -- treatment-emergent adverse events and events of special interest -- not cardiovascular events.' That is FACTUALLY WRONG. NCT02666664 registers THIRTEEN primary outcomes and the SECOND is 'Percentage of Participants With Adjudicated Major Adverse Cardiovascular Event'. It has a MACE primary.
why_not_contributing_CORRECTED_2026_08_1.how_the_error_happened: The object stores `registered_primary_measure` as a SCALAR holding ONE of the trial's thirteen primaries -- the first, TEAEs -- and the exclusion reason was written by characterising all primaries from that single value. A scalar field standing for a list is how the other twelve became invisible.
why_not_contributing_CORRECTED_2026_08_1.the_verdict_still_stands_but_on_a_differ: EXCLUDE is still correct. The failing limb is POPULATION, not OUTCOME: this is CLEAR Harmony, in high-cardiovascular-risk patients on maximally tolerated statin therapy, whereas the review's population limb is statin-intolerant patients.
why_not_contributing_CORRECTED_2026_08_1.class: A correct verdict reached by broken reasoning. It passed every outcome-based check because the outcome -- exclusion -- was right. Only reading the REASON against the registry caught it, and only because the withholding question is asked at every rank rather than at the primary alone.

studies.name: CLEAR Serenity
studies.why_not_contributing: its registered primary is PERCENT CHANGE IN LDL-C AT WEEK 12, a laboratory value. Correctly excluded from a MACE estimate.
studies.registered_primary_measure: Percent Change From Baseline (PCFB) in Low-density Lipoprotein Cholesterol (LDL-C) at Week 12
studies.registered_primary_description_verbatim: PCFB was calculated as the (\[post-Baseline (BL) value minus the BL value\] divided by the BL value ) x 100. BL was defined as the mean of the last two non-missing values on or prior to Day 1. If only one value was available, that single value was used as BL. PCFB in LDL-C was analyzed using analysis of covariance (ANCOVA), with treatment group and stratification factor (primary prevention; secondary prevention) as fixed effects and BL as a covariate. For participants with missing lipid data at Week 12 who were no longer taking study treatment, missing values were imputed using multiple imputation via a regression-based model including stratification and BL data from placebo participants only. In this imputation model, treatment group was not included. For participants with missing lipid data at Week 12 who were still taking study treatment, missing values were imputed using multiple imputation via a regression-based model including treatment, stratification and BL value.
studies.what_the_registry_holds_that_the_page_do: LDL-C percent change -22.58 against -1.17, least-squares mean difference -21.41 (-25.13 to -17.70)

pooled.stands_because: THE ESTIMATE STANDS, AND IT IS ONE TRIAL'S RESULT RATHER THAN A SYNTHESIS -- which the card says, with k=1. HR 0.87 (0.79 to 0.96) IS CLEAR Outcomes' own registered Cox analysis, digit for digit, over its registered primary outcome: 'Number of Participants With First Occurrence of Four Component Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events (MACE)', defined by its registry record as 'death from cardiovascular causes, nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, or coronary revascularization, as assessed in a time-to first-event analysis'. Its counts are the registry's own: 819 of 6,992 against 927 of 6,978. AND k=1 IS CORRECT RATHER THAN A SHORTFALL. Of the four registrations this page includes, ONLY CLEAR Outcomes registers a cardiovascular-event primary. CLEAR Harmony's registered primaries are SAFETY endpoints -- treatment-emergent adverse events and events of special interest, at 52 weeks. CLEAR Serenity's is PERCENT CHANGE IN LDL-C AT WEEK 12, a laboratory value. Neither can enter a MACE estimate, so leaving them out is right; what is missing is any statement that they were left out or why.
pooled.caveats: THREE THINGS A READER SHOULD KNOW, NONE OF WHICH OVERTURNS THE ESTIMATE. (1) ONE OF THE FOUR INCLUDED REGISTRATIONS IS NOT A BEMPEDOIC ACID TRIAL AT ALL. NCT02973841 is 'Sono-ease', a FORTY-PATIENT DEVICE STUDY of internal jugular vein cannulation whose registered primary outcome is 'complications rate'. It sits in this page's own include list. It carries no data record, so it touches no number here -- but it is the second wrong registration found in this corpus in one session, after NCT02583191 turned out to be a German treatment-satisfaction study on DOAC_CANCER_VTE. A registration that names an unrelated trial is invisible to every check that asks only whether an id is present and unique. (2) THE PUBLISHED-COMPARISON STEP COMPARES THIS ESTIMATE AGAINST ITSELF. The page's benchmark database holds exactly one entry for this outcome: 'CLEAR Outcomes bempedoic acid vs placebo', Nissen 2023, HR 0.87 (0.79 to 0.96), k=1, n=13,970. That IS the trial whose result is on the card. A comparison of a number with itself agrees perfectly and establishes NOTHING, and the agreement should not be read as external corroboration. THE HONEST DENOMINATOR HERE IS ZERO: no independent synthesis of this estimand is recorded on this page. (3) A SINGLE TRIAL IS NOT A SYNTHESIS. Nothing here is pooled, there is no heterogeneity to report, and the interval is CLEAR Outcomes' own. The value of this page over reading the trial report is the provenance chain, not the statistics.
pooled.card_note: k=1 and that is CORRECT, not a shortfall: only CLEAR Outcomes registers a cardiovascular-event primary. The value is the registry's own Cox analysis. One of the four included registrations, NCT02973841, is NOT a bempedoic acid trial

primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.

build_stamp._ratchet: This page is stamped to the standard version above. If the standard rises, this page is BELOW it and knowably so. No page is grandfathered; arni-hfref is presently UNSTAMPED and is therefore unknown-version, not compliant.

screening_of_remainder.screened_against: screening.eligibility_provenance -- the DERIVED criteria block (predefined:false, post_hoc:true). This screen is the first test of whether a derived block can do the work criteria are for: admitting and excluding named trials with reasons. It could.
screening_of_remainder.k_unchanged_because: None of the 16 met all four limbs. k stays at 1, and P6 therefore continues to refuse a pooled model -- but it now refuses on a SCREENED basis rather than an unexamined one, which is a different and stronger statement.

withholding_question.asked: does this trial report, AT ANY RANK -- primary, secondary or other -- an outcome matching what the included trial reports as its primary?
withholding_question.why_asked_before_deciding_not_to_pool: Reading only registered PRIMARIES is how a poolable outcome one rank down goes unseen. Two of the three MACE-matching outcomes found here sit at SECONDARY rank and a primaries-only screen would have missed both.

restated_two_axis_2026_08_19.why: sglt2-hf's criteria showed the right structure: ELIGIBILITY turns on population, intervention and comparator and deliberately NOT on what a trial reported, because making eligibility depend on reported outcomes invites outcome-reporting bias. POOLABILITY is a separate axis. The original screen of these 16 used the outcome as an ELIGIBILITY limb and excluded 13 on it. Restated here. The ratchet says no page is grandfathered, including one built four hours earlier.
restated_two_axis_2026_08_19.what_the_restatement_changed: The original reported 13 failing on the OUTCOME limb. Under two axes only TWO trials are ELIGIBLE-but-not-poolable -- because most of those 13 ALSO fail population or comparator. The original screen checked OUTCOME FIRST and returned on the first failure, so the limb it REPORTED was determined by CHECK ORDER rather than by the trial. The verdict (exclude) was right every time; the attributed reason was an artifact of the order I wrote the checks in. Same class as everything else tonight -- right answer, wrong reason, invisible to anything that reads verdicts.
restated_two_axis_2026_08_19.three_that_are_poolable_but_not_eligible: Three trials report a MACE-matching outcome yet fail population or comparator. They could contribute a quantity but are out of scope, which is the opposite cell from the eleven eligible-but-not-poolable on sglt2-hf. Both cells are only visible under two axes.
restated_two_axis_2026_08_19.k_unchanged: k stays 1. No trial is both eligible and poolable.
